title: REGIONAL FIELD GEOLOGY OF THE PACIFIC NORTHWEST
rpt_for_credit: This course is repeatable for 9 credits
description: Experience the highly varied geology of Oregon. Explore field geology sites, discover the diversity of world class geology in driving distance from Corvallis, and learn how to find, analyze, and understand these sites. Includes field trips.
registration_restrictions: Enrollment limited to students in the Coll of Earth, Ocean and Atmos college.
clssnotes:
Pre-trip meeting Friday, September 25 from 3:00-3:50 pm. Field trip to Painted Hills and John Day Fossil Beds depart OSU 8:00 am Saturday, October 17. Return to OSU by 7:00 pm on Sunday, October 18. Post-trip meeting Friday, October 30 from 3:00-3:50 pm. Contact the instructor at kaplan.yalcin@oregonstate.edu for additional information.
